rules: No BVPS readiness conclusion without imported official response packet, hash, DLP screening, proofcut mapping, and adjudication.
Only requests in cube/bvps-canonical-dispatch-batch-rev0378.csv are active for dispatch; superseded packets must not be sent without a new revision decision.
Dispatch receipts, acknowledgements, route corrections, public notices, and general public plans are not readiness evidence.
Every active request must have a receipt sidecar before a response can support proofcut credit.
Deadline clocks begin only after actual custodian receipt; rev0378 clock dates are planning estimates until sidecars are completed.
EN58200 remains a trigger until EOF repair/retest/CAP closure evidence is imported.
FEMA Region 3/Region 5, Pennsylvania, Ohio/Columbiana, West Virginia/Hancock, and NRC routes remain distinct even when federal FEMA dispatch is consolidated.
Derived file/source normalization tables must cover every file id present in cube/index.csv.
